verdict.rationale: Fireflies ships an AI assistant (AskFred), so letting users plug in external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. The evidence only documents Fireflies acting as an MCP server, exposing its meeting data and tools to ChatGPT and other AI clients. Nothing shows Fireflies or AskFred connecting to third-party MCP servers as a client, and server-side evidence does not count toward this client-side story.
